subject.title: fix(ollama): preserve custom memory provider endpoints

question: Should endpoint-aware Ollama cache identity intentionally trigger one memory-index rebuild for existing installations?
rationale: Preventing stale vectors from crossing endpoint changes requires a new provider key, but automation cannot decide whether that upgrade cost is acceptable or whether maintainers want a compatibility strategy.

options.title: Accept endpoint-aware rebuild
options.body: Land the new identity after current-head proof shows that changing one provider id's endpoint rebuilds rather than reusing stale vectors.

options.title: Preserve legacy identity
options.body: Pause and design a migration or alias if existing Ollama indexes must retain their provider keys across this upgrade.

recommendation.title: Accept endpoint-aware rebuild
recommendation.body: Land the new identity after current-head proof shows that changing one provider id's endpoint rebuilds rather than reusing stale vectors.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available exact-path history signal, although official decision authority is not established by the available history.
